## Updates

{% data variables.product.prodname_vscode_shortname %} ships weekly [releases](/updates). If the {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode_shortname %} repository is installed correctly, the system package manager handles auto-update the same way it handles other packages on the system.

> [!NOTE]
> Updates are automatic and run in the background for the [Snap package](#snap-package).
